INSERT INTO organization_env_vars (organization_id, name, encrypted_value)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
            RETURNING
                id              AS "id!: Uuid",
                organization_id AS "organization_id!: Uuid",
                name            AS "name!",
                created_at      AS "created_at!",
                updated_at      AS "updated_at!"
